package api

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"example.com/ledger/store"
	"example.com/ledger/transfer"
)

func TestHiddenService(t *testing.T) {
	sv := Service{Store: store.New()}
	a, err := sv.Open("a1", "Ada")
	if err != nil || a.Currency != "EUR" {
		t.Fatalf("open gave %+v, %v", a, err)
	}
	if _, err := sv.Open("b2", "Bo"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := sv.Transfer("a1", "b2", 300); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, err := sv.Balance("b2"); err != nil || got != 300 {
		t.Fatalf("balance %d, %v", got, err)
	}
	if err := sv.Transfer("a1", "a1", 1); !errors.Is(err, transfer.ErrSameAccount) {
		t.Fatalf("same account gave %v", err)
	}
	for name, err := range map[string]error{
		"Balance":  func() error { _, err := sv.Balance("zz"); return err }(),
		"Freeze":   sv.Freeze("zz"),
		"Transfer": sv.Transfer("zz", "a1", 1),
	} {
		if !errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
			t.Fatalf("%s of a missing id gave %v", name, err)
		}
	}
}
